environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule with RegexPatternSet matching request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|(?:\'|\")--)` with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode at priority 5. Additionally, the EC2 instance runs with an AppArmor profile that restricts the SQLite process to read-only access on /var/lib/app/users.db (deny write operations), and the application's systemd unit sets MemoryMax=256M and IPAddressDeny=any for outbound connections from the app process (preventing data exfiltration via out-of-band channels).

wafv2_webacl.rule_2: Custom RegexPatternSet on query_string values: (?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|(?:\'|\")--)  action=BLOCK priority=1

config.apparmor_profile: /etc/apparmor.d/usr.bin.app - denies write to /var/lib/app/users.db, allows read only
